Website swlaw.com Snell & Wilmer is an American law firm based in Phoenix, Arizona . Founded in 1938, the firm represents clients ranging from large, publicly traded corporations, to small businesses, individuals and entrepreneurs. [ 1 ] Barbara J. Dawson is the chair.
